projects.title: Strategy Control
projects.head: 3868cd2658ebb8621444dd40a3e3320550435a79
projects.practical_disposition: The user-approved and durably registered zero-cost research space is exhausted without a prospectively validated candidate. Both approved point-in-time universe routes are terminal, so the ordered cross-sectional queue remains economically unevaluated. Some fixed-pair experiments retain diagnostic historical no-go results, while calendar seasonality and equal-weight volatility management were consumed without economic results. This does not claim that every conceivable public dataset or crypto strategy is impossible. Every final holdout remained closed and unread, no candidate was promoted, and capital remains zero.
